items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Mel Mandel who wrote the book... So it seems that he put up the money for the show... we would do 'My Old Friends'... Mel Mandel who had written the music. Mel wrote the book... I got a Tony Nomination for my performance in the show.

ctx.x: Yeah, 1978. And Mel Mandel who wrote the book and it was written for seniors, you know, about seniors, and Andrew Stein who is the Borough President of Manhattan became interested because one of his projects has to do with senior citizens. He's very interested. So it seems that he put up the money for the show to open at the La Mama. And part of the arrangement was that we would do "My Old Friends" in each of the five boroughs. That we would do a performance in each of the five boroughs. So we did and of course…
